integrity: The Paley–Wiener detached-piece asymptotic follows from an exact weighted-discrepancy integral, the strict curvature of the interval optimizer, an O(epsilon*b) center shift, and the quadratic spectral-versus-discrepancy estimate in Zelent (2026). The local calculation has been checked against the stated domain and source normalization.
scientific_limitations: The coefficient applies for every fixed s>0, epsilon->0, b>=epsilon and b->0. No fixed-b or second-term asymptotic is established. The method depends on published interval optimality, prolate regularity, and a strong stability comparison. Historical priority of this short corollary is best-of-knowledge.
title: Exact detachment crossover for Paley–Wiener concentration
